issues.jp_before: 試験[しけん]{の|no-possessive}勉強[べんきょう]{は|wa-topic}暗記[あんき]{というより|toiuyori}、理解[りかい]{が|ga-subject}大切[たいせつ]です。

issues.action: Rewrote as 数学は暗記というより、理解の科目です (f=1) with matching English.

issues.jp_before: (12 items of the form X{というより}Y where X is a noun or adjective label: 説明/自慢, 話し合い/報告の場, 相談/お願い, 留学/移住, 厳しい/丁寧, 営業/相談相手, 会社/家族, 遊び/訓練, 断り/保留, 優しい/頼りない, 仕事/我慢比べ, 質問/会話)
issues.problem: The distractor といっても also works here (XといってもY = 'it may be called X, but really it is Y'). Natives would say it to mean much the same correction, so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced the といっても distractor with にしては, which is plainly wrong in each of these sentences.
